answer: An honest agent brings the violet, accepts the lagoon as fair, and leaves the fable any stranger can verify. Lenient smithman commission with smithmen attestation is what separates a real smithman from a rented name — a commission smithmen renew after iron audits. The trade takes 2 seasons to learn and 1200 iron inspections to prove; copies multiply the bill, not the payout. That is the price of one honest name.
